name: st-cloud-desktop
description: 星云盘 PC 桌面客户端

scripts.dev:electron: tsup src/main.ts src/preload.ts --format cjs --outDir dist && electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:web && electron-builder
scripts.test: tsc src/sync-retry.ts src/sync-retry.test.ts src/db-migrate.ts src/db-migrate.test.ts src/sync-utils.ts src/sync-utils.test.ts --outDir .test-dist --module commonjs --target ES2020 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node --test ".test-dist/*.test.js"
